building_stock: The Maidstone VIC records point to a split door stock rather than one dominant type: the local supplier page sells fitting keyless locks and digital entry to 'both modern and established homes throughout the Maidstone region' (auslock.com.au/pages/locksmith/maidstone), while the Maidstone VIC job feed shows one conventional entry door where a smart deadbolt goes in as a like-for-like swap 'with an additional mounting plate' and a separate glass patio opening that has to be made lockable (airtasker.com/au/services/locksmith/maidstone-vic) — so an installer here should expect both straight deadbolt retrofits and glazed sliding/patio openings that will not take a standard smart deadbolt.

common_concerns: Whether a smart deadbolt goes straight into the existing deadbolt cut-out or means modifying the door — a Maidstone VIC job is posted in exactly those terms: 'Installation of a new smart deadbolt lock. Same installation procedure as a regular deadbolt, but with an additional mounting plate' (airtasker.com/au/services/locksmith/maidstone-vic).

Securing the glazed rear/patio opening, not just the front entry door — a separate Maidstone VIC job asks for a lockable dog door fitted into 'a glass patio' (airtasker.com/au/services/locksmith/maidstone-vic), so demand here reaches doors that a standard smart deadbolt cannot be fitted to.

Whether keyless entry can be fitted to an older house at all, or only to a new build — the supplier page serving Maidstone pre-empts that doubt directly, specialising in 'fitting the latest keyless locks and digital entry systems to both modern and established homes throughout the Maidstone region' (auslock.com.au/pages/locksmith/maidstone).
